time_convention_details: Selected means, output curves and selected-reference controls use the requested comparison clock. Historical numerical/method tables use the original simultaneous geometric UTC convention. Observer-arrival mapping uses geometric Earth as XMM proxy and same-emission-epoch comet velocity; final light-time audit independently checks interpolation/quadrature.

reference_selection.author: Codex-root
reference_selection.status: Final conditional CT reference; all selected finite numerical and exposure criteria pass
reference_selection.selection_rationale: Finest completed physically/source-qualified nominal case. All four prospectively registered selected directional pairs pass original pointwise and separate PN exposure criteria, including latitude refinement at both radial baselines; baseline timestep/domain/spinup/moderate outer controls pass in their recorded scope. Earlier latitude/radial-exposure failures and unresolved physical controls remain explicit history. No empirical-accuracy or absolute-error guarantee.
reference_selection.accuracy_scope: Conditional model estimate; recorded coarse controls do not establish all fine-grid interactions or empirical accuracy. Failed and unqualified physical responses are evidence, not uncertainty bounds.

qualification_at_selection.scope: Immutable selection-time evidence. Product pipeline independently refreshes current audits before deriving final products.

caveat: Parameter min/max envelope is a sensitivity range, not a confidence interval. No contemporaneous heavy-ion abundance measured at the comet.
